exceptions.justification: After the composition-test ownership audit, this class is the retained cross-subsystem TUI composition suite; focused subsystem behavior belongs in focused test modules and this baseline may not silently grow.

The compatibility facade delegates the per-item voice editor open/completion through two focused-owner hooks without owning the feature behavior. The reviewed interface grows from 51 to 53 methods for #285; subsequent growth requires its own focused ownership review.

The shared operation-lifecycle facade remains the composition point for focused playback, conflict, acceptance, and worker-event owners; new responsibilities must stay in focused owners and this baseline may not silently grow.
